svg.desc: Real Icarus VCD transitions. Fault-injected isolated mutation compared with current repaired RTL. Absolute simulation time in nanoseconds; delta updates at a timestamp show their final settled value.
svg.text: MEASURED RTL WAVEFORMS / TWO CONTROLLED RUNS
Forwarding priority: the newest producer must win

Gold band: ADD operand selection. Dashed line: checked retirement at PC 0x8, cycle 9.
Repaired RTL / newer EX/MEM value wins
Checked retirement: r2 = 0x00000006; independent ISS expects 0x00000006. Complete trace and final architectural state PASS.
Gold band: ADD operand selection. Dashed line: checked retirement at PC 0x8, cycle 9.
